verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud decisioning SaaS, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no MCP server. The llms.txt docs index, OpenAPI document, and 'agentic automation' marketing are adjacent machine-readable or marketing surfaces, not an MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
